governing_bodies.name: ICMR-NIN 2020
governing_bodies.explanation: We use the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) energy requirements to calculate exact, age-specific daily limits for your family.

governing_bodies.name: WHO 2015
governing_bodies.explanation: The World Health Organization recommends that 'free sugars' stay under 10% of your total daily energy intake. For a standard adult diet, this is roughly 50g (or 12 teaspoons) per day.

governing_bodies.name: FSSAI 2020
governing_bodies.explanation: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India mandates how nutrition labels must be printed, including the standard Reference Daily Allowance (RDA) used to calculate percentages.

10+.label: Age 10 and over
10+.warning: FSSAI/WHO standard RDA for adults (2000 kcal).

under-2.label: Under 2 years
under-2.warning: Added sugar and salt are not recommended under age 2.
